messages:
maria: Escalation from ACME — rerank returning 422 or weird zero scores when they include a "query" field at both top-level and inside documents. Customer attached a minimal repro and says it used to work.

maria: customer payload (copied):
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank -H 'Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"query":"how to reset password","documents":[{"id":"d1","query":"how to reset password","passages":[{"text":"Reset via /settings"}]},{"id":"d2","passages":[{"text":"Password reset link"}]}],"candidates":[{"id":"c1","text":"Reset in account"}]}'
```

alex: can you paste the exact 422 body they got?

maria: here's the response from our gateway (from the customer):
```json
{"error":"Invalid payload: ambiguous 'query' field found in document[0] and root; precedence unknown","code":422}
```

jordan: :eyes: thanks. quick context — our rerank parser historically treated the top-level `query` as the canonical query. If a `query` exists on candidates/docs, those are treated as overrides. There was a behavior change in the "payload parser" refactor (2025-09) that accidentally reversed precedence for some nested shapes.

sam: can you repro locally in sandbox? minimal steps please.

maria: repro steps I used in staging:
1) POST the payload above to /v1/rerank with a real API key (sandbox).
2) Observe 422 from gateway.
3) Check service logs:
```text
[2025-09-15T14:02:33.112Z] request_id=abc123 parse_payload INFO incoming payload size=1.2KB
[2025-09-15T14:02:33.113Z] request_id=abc123 parse_payload DEBUG found_fields root.query, documents[0].query
[2025-09-15T14:02:33.113Z] request_id=abc123 parse_payload WARN ambiguous_query_fields ["root.query","documents[0].query"]
[2025-09-15T14:02:33.114Z] request_id=abc123 parse_payload ERROR returning 422 due to ambiguity
```

jordan: ok that log confirms the parser flagged ambiguity. Expected behavior (per spec) is: prefer top-level `query` unless a candidate/document explicitly sets a different ``query_for_ranking`` field. The bug is the parser currently fails fast instead of applying precedence.

alex: suggested workaround for customer ASAP?

maria: told customer two options: 1) move the query to top-level only (remove `query` keys from docs), or 2) rename doc-level query key (e.g., `doc_query` / `query_text`) and pass the document text in `passages[].text` / `candidates[].text`. Both fixed the issue in staging. I included a one-line example: 
```json
{"query":"how to reset password","documents":[{"id":"d1","doc_query":"how to reset password","passages":[{"text":"Reset via /settings"}]}],"candidates":[{"id":"c1","text":"Reset in account"}]}
```

jordan: I'll open an engineering ticket to restore the intended precedence and make the error message clearer. created INF-12487 and linked logs. patch plan: accept root.query before doc-level, and if both present, log a single INFO that doc-level was ignored (no 4xx).

support-bot: Incident created: INF-12487 by jordan. Priority: P2. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-12487

sam: timeline? can we get a hotfix or at least a documented workaround?

jordan: hotfix target in next deploy window (48h). will push a validator change that maps ambiguous cases to top-level. I'll also add a linter rule to the SDKs to warn when `query` exists at multiple levels.

maria: updated customer with workaround and told them to expect a fix within ~48h. they replied asking for a test-case so they can validate post-fix.

alex: please add a small regression test that posts the original payload and asserts no 422 and expected ranking behavior. assign to jordan. :thumbsup:

jordan: added test to rerank-parser-suite (unit + e2e). PR will reference INF-12487.

maria: closing loop with ACME — they confirmed workaround works for now and will switch to top-level query in prod. asked to be notified when fix is live.

sam: nice. follow-up: add doc note in ranking API docs about `query` precedence and examples showing `doc_query` pattern.

maria: done — doc PR created (docs#489).

jordan: will mark INF-12487 resolved after hotfix deploy and regression CI passes.

maria: thanks everyone. tagging @jordan to keep customer updated on the ticket.
